heroTitle: Turn team challenges into priorities for AI adoption
lead: An intensive journey to identify and prioritize use cases and outline an implementation plan connected to what the SON.IA platform already executes. Format, scope, and terms are defined in a commercial conversation.
contextTitle: From AI curiosity to relevant next steps
context: Companies may recognize artificial intelligence opportunities without knowing which challenges to prioritize or how to connect them to operations. The immersion works from the team's use cases, without assuming results, timeline, or a standardized plan.
solutionTitle: An intensive journey focused on the team's challenges
solutionText: The AI Immersion aims to leave with prioritized use cases and a clear implementation plan connected to what the SON.IA platform already executes. Facilitation, activities, and specific scope must be validated for each engagement.
audiences: Teams that need to identify AI opportunities related to their own work.
Companies seeking to prioritize potential use cases before moving to implementation.
Organizations interested in connecting AI initiatives to what SON.IA already executes.

goals.title: Identify opportunities
goals.text: Explore use cases tied to challenges raised by the team; outcomes depend on context and agreed scope.

goals.title: Prioritize use cases
goals.text: Organize opportunities as a focus for discussion and prioritization, with no guarantee of feasibility or business outcome.

goals.title: Guide next steps
goals.text: Outline an implementation plan to be connected to SON.IA capabilities and validated against the company's reality.

flow.title: Align context
flow.text: Gather team challenges and needs; format and discovery activities must be confirmed in the proposal.

flow.title: Explore use cases
flow.text: Work through AI application possibilities related to the stated context, without assuming a specific official dynamic.

flow.title: Prioritize opportunities
flow.text: Define priority use cases within agreed scope; criteria and prioritization method must be confirmed.

flow.title: Outline implementation
flow.text: Connect the implementation plan to what SON.IA already executes; content, level of detail, and responsibilities will be defined in the proposal.

methodology: The briefing describes an intensive journey and its objectives but does not state duration, workload, format, agenda, official methodology, or team composition. These elements, along with prioritization criteria and implementation plan scope, must be confirmed in a commercial proposal before engagement.
deliverables: Prioritized use cases — scope, record format, and criteria to be confirmed in proposal.
Clear implementation plan — content, level of detail, format, and responsibilities to be confirmed in proposal.

differentiators.title: Grounded in the team's reality
differentiators.text: The proposal is oriented to the team's use cases and challenges, per the briefing.

differentiators.title: Priority before implementation
differentiators.text: The journey seeks to prioritize use cases and outline next steps, without guaranteeing results.

differentiators.title: Connected to SON.IA
differentiators.text: The plan is presented as connected to what the platform already executes; specific capabilities must be verified in commercial scope.

faqs.q: What is the format of the immersion?
faqs.a: The briefing does not state whether it is in person, remote, or hybrid. Format must be confirmed in a commercial conversation.

faqs.q: How long does it last and what is the workload?
faqs.a: Duration and workload were not provided; they will be defined and confirmed in the proposal.

The journey aims to produce prioritized use cases and a clear implementation plan. Format, content, and limits of these deliverables must appear in the proposal; no additional deliverables are confirmed.

faqs.q: How does engagement work and what are the timelines?
faqs.a: Commercial terms, availability, timelines, and engagement process are not stated. Request a conversation for validation.

faqs.q: Does the immersion guarantee implementation or results?
faqs.a: No guarantee is stated. The immersion aims to prioritize use cases and outline a plan; eventual implementation and its results depend on scope and terms to be confirmed.
